decisions.decision: Q2 FY24 commitment tabled at the Business Manager's request until the billing issue is resolved and she has talked to the town accountant.
decisions.quote: paula asked to table this until she can get the billing issue resolved and talk to the town accountant.

decisions.decision: Business Manager and DPW Director to draft IMA language for the Leominster subcommittee.
decisions.quote: paula said she and bill will come up with some language and give it to the subcommittee.

decisions.decision: Draft Leominster IMA language to be reviewed through the board before it is sent to Leominster.
decisions.quote: dave added it should be then reviewed through the board prior to sending to leominster.

decisions.decision: Ratepayer rate increase to be discussed at the 11/28 meeting.
decisions.quote: they will need to discuss this at the 11/28 meeting.

decisions.decision: Chair to meet with the Business Manager on a software conversion timeline and email Heather and the Select Board.
decisions.quote: john said he will meet with paula to do timeline on the issue and send an email to heather and select board.

decisions.decision: Robert Lilly (CTE) asked to look at a macerator before the pumps as a viable option.
decisions.quote: she asked robert to look at putting a macerator before the pumps, as a viable option.

decisions.decision: Maintenance Plan to be discussed at the January meeting; Business Manager to get a quote for wet well cleaning work.
decisions.quote: dave asked to discuss the maintenance plan in january.

decisions.decision: The 12/26 Commission meeting cancelled, by consensus with all in favor and no motion recorded.
decisions.quote: john asked the commissioners if they wanted to cancel the meeting on 12/26 and all were in favor.
